spec.description: CPU, memory, I/O, threads and handles per process of one Windows host.

spec.expr: sum by (process, process_id) (rate(windows_process_cpu_time_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", process=~"$process", process_id!="0"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (process, process_id) topk($process_top, sum by (process, process_id) (rate(windows_process_cpu_time_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", process=~"$process", process_id!="0"}[$__rate_interval] @ end())))

spec.description: User and privileged CPU time per process as a share of one logical processor. Values above 100% mean the process uses more than one core. Shows the Top N selected processes ranked at the end of the time range; that set stays fixed throughout the graph. Requires the process collector.
spec.title: Process CPU usage

spec.expr: windows_process_working_set_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", process=~"$process", process_id!="0"} and on (process, process_id) topk($process_top, windows_process_working_set_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", process=~"$process", process_id!="0"} @ end())

spec.description: Physical memory in the working set of each process, including shared pages. Shows the Top N selected processes ranked at the end of the time range; that set stays fixed throughout the graph. Requires the process collector.
spec.title: Process working set

spec.expr: windows_process_private_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", process=~"$process", process_id!="0"} and on (process, process_id) topk($process_top, windows_process_private_bytes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", process=~"$process", process_id!="0"} @ end())

spec.description: Memory allocated by each process that cannot be shared with other processes. Shows the Top N selected processes ranked at the end of the time range; that set stays fixed throughout the graph. Requires the process collector.
spec.title: Process private bytes

spec.expr: sum by (process, process_id) (rate(windows_process_io_bytes_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", process=~"$process", process_id!="0"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (process, process_id) topk($process_top, sum by (process, process_id) (rate(windows_process_io_bytes_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", process=~"$process", process_id!="0"}[$__rate_interval] @ end())))

spec.description: Total bytes issued for read, write and other I/O per process, including file, network and device operations. Shows the Top N selected processes ranked at the end of the time range; that set stays fixed throughout the graph. Requires the process collector.
spec.title: Process I/O throughput

spec.expr: windows_process_threads{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", process=~"$process", process_id!="0"} and on (process, process_id) topk($process_top, windows_process_threads{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", process=~"$process", process_id!="0"} @ end())

spec.description: Active threads in each process. Shows the Top N selected processes ranked at the end of the time range; that set stays fixed throughout the graph. Requires the process collector.
spec.title: Process threads

spec.expr: windows_process_handles{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", process=~"$process", process_id!="0"} and on (process, process_id) topk($process_top, windows_process_handles{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", process=~"$process", process_id!="0"} @ end())

spec.description: Open handles in each process. Steady growth can indicate a handle leak. Shows the Top N selected processes ranked at the end of the time range; that set stays fixed throughout the graph. Requires the process collector.
spec.title: Process handles

spec.expr: sum by (process, process_id) (rate(windows_process_io_operations_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", process=~"$process", process_id!="0"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (process, process_id) topk($process_top, sum by (process, process_id) (rate(windows_process_io_operations_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", process=~"$process", process_id!="0"}[$__rate_interval] @ end())))

spec.description: Total read, write and other I/O operations per second per process. Includes file, network and device I/O. Shows the Top N selected processes ranked at the end of the time range; that set stays fixed throughout the graph. Requires the process collector.
spec.title: Process I/O operations

spec.expr: rate(windows_process_page_faults_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", process=~"$process", process_id!="0"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (process, process_id) topk($process_top, rate(windows_process_page_faults_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", process=~"$process", process_id!="0"}[$__rate_interval] @ end()))

spec.description: Page faults per second by each process, including soft faults that do not require reading from disk. Shows the Top N selected processes ranked at the end of the time range; that set stays fixed throughout the graph. Requires the process collector.
spec.title: Process page faults

spec.description: Number of distinct process IDs currently collected, excluding Idle. Includes all selected processes, regardless of Top N. Requires the process collector.
spec.title: Processes

spec.description: Total active threads in the selected processes. Includes all selected processes, regardless of Top N. Requires the process collector.
spec.title: Threads

spec.description: Total open handles in the selected processes. Includes all selected processes, regardless of Top N. Requires the process collector.
spec.title: Handles

spec.description: CPU time used by the selected processes as a share of all logical processors of the host, excluding Idle. Includes all selected processes, regardless of Top N. Requires the process collector.
spec.title: CPU busy

spec.description: Physical memory private to the selected processes; shared pages are excluded. Includes all selected processes, regardless of Top N. Requires the process collector.
spec.title: Private working set

spec.description: Total memory allocated by the selected processes that cannot be shared; it may include nonresident memory. Includes all selected processes, regardless of Top N. Requires the process collector.
spec.title: Private bytes
Windows Exporter / Processes

spec.description: Maximum number of processes per graph. Summary counters include all selected processes.
spec.label: Top N processes
